decisions.reason: The organic superfood drink mix lies far outside the firm's announced waste-to-energy direction and carries little public commitment, so there is little sunk cost or reputation to justify keeping it, and its resources would be better redirected to the core WASTX line.

The modular plant extensions complement the core waste-to-energy plants and have been visible since 2018, so management will likely keep them and treat the missing web presence after 2019 as a temporary issue rather than a failure.

WASTX Oil was launched with a dated public press release and had its own page from the start, which makes it a flagship of the firm's announced decentralized waste-to-energy strategy that management is strongly committed to defending.

The plastic-to-fuel plant is central to the firm's publicly announced waste-to-energy direction and was given more prominence in 2019, so the heavy investment and the need to justify earlier decisions favor persisting despite uncertain results.
